items.title: VIG’s Index Removes the Highest-Yielding 25% of Dividend Stocks Before Holders Ever Own Them
items.summary: VIG markets itself to dividend seekers, yet its own rulebook quietly bars a swath of the highest-paying stocks from ever entering the fund. Understanding exactly how that screen works changes the math on what you are actually collecting each year.

items.title: Does Tutor Perini (TPC) Have the Potential to Rally 25.37% as Wall Street Analysts Expect?
